zh.title: 说明
items: 本版本完成 Desktop 向原生 Rust Peer Core 的全量收敛（ADR 133），首次将 Rust Peer Core（`peer-native.exe`）完整移植至 Windows MSVC（零 `unsafe` 代码）并随三端桌面安装包原生内置；同时带来 Bot 级 Skills/MCP 能力挂载、ADR 134 桌面与 Bot 交互升级、Peer Frost v2 磨砂视觉体系以及原生 TUI 全面升级。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **Desktop 全量收敛至原生 Rust Peer Core（ADR 133）**：Classic 对话/计划/目标模式、项目 Bot 宿主、自动化任务、项目记忆与目标追踪、共享本地 Daemon 与远程连接器全部统一运行于原生 Rust Peer Core，正式退役遗留 TypeScript 桌面引擎。

**Windows 原生 Rust Peer Core 支持**：`peer-store`、`peer-runtime`、`peer-cli` 与 `peer-core-rpc` 完整支持 Windows MSVC 构建与测试（Named Pipe 守护进程、UTF-8 PowerShell 执行与 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 抑制弹窗闪烁、`sysinfo` 进程监督、NTFS 持久化适配、零 `unsafe`）。macOS、Windows、Linux 三端桌面安装包均原生内置 `peer-native`、`peer-credential-helper` 与内置 Skill 市场目录。

**GPT-6.2 订阅模型支持（#335）**：ChatGPT 订阅内置目录与原生 CLI OAuth 合约新增 **GPT-6.2 Astra**（`gpt-6.2-astra`）与 **GPT-6.2 Sol**（`gpt-6.2-sol`），支持 400K / 1M 上下文档位、128K 输出、全五档推理强度与官方标准/长上下文定价，并将默认订阅模型升级为 `gpt-6.2-astra`。
**内置只读联网检索与批量检索（#348、#349）**：为项目 Bot 与只读子任务新增内置 `web_search`（`local.web.search`）与 `web_fetch` 能力，并完善桌面端 `BatchSearchToolCard` 对 Rust `local_tool_result_ref` 与失败态的解码展示。
**OpenUI 交互式结果卡片原生接入与主 Bot 直出（#339、#341）**：Rust 桌面宿主完整打通交互式交付卡片发布、核验与内联渲染，主 Bot 与子任务均可直接在对话气泡内呈现交互式卡片。
**对话优先子任务工作区与实时内联委派体验（#345、#350、#351）**：重写子任务视图为对话优先工作区，支持直接绑定实时 Worker 会话流、合并 Rust Worker 流式工具步骤、在主对话内联展示委派任务行与回复确认。
**模块化小猫头像工坊与 Bot 欢迎页重塑（#343、#346）**：上线三色调谐模块化小猫头像定制器与全新项目 Bot 欢迎舞台，统一工作面板与活动行执行器图标。
**浏览器标签式资源工作台顶栏（#342）**：将右侧文档/交付工作台顶栏精简为浏览器风格标签栏（ADR 125 Plan A）。
**Bot 级 Skills 与 MCP 能力挂载与默认角色模型路由（#352、#353）**：Skills 与 MCP 能力支持直接挂载至项目 Bot；子任务继承 Bot 已保存的权限边界；Rust 核心与桌面设置页默认应用角色分级模型路由。
**退役 Qoder CLI 与 Gemini OAuth 通道（#347，ADR 136）**：清理遗留 Qoder 私有适配器与 Gemini OAuth 路径，统一收口至标准渠道。
**ADR 134 桌面与 Bot 交互升级**：新增侧边栏任务视图、底部 Touch Bar、全宽任务工作区、人声双通道 Bot 对话界面，以及改版后的个性化设置（支持全局沟通风格继承与系统指令透传）。
**Peer Frost v2 A×G 磨砂视觉体系与品牌启动页**：全部桌面渲染层样式与模型路由设置页完成统一迁移，上线 Q 弹小猫剪影透视启动页（#329），同步升级官网视觉（#330 `docs/`），消除延迟面板切换时的无样式加载闪烁，并同步 `<html lang>`。
**原生 Ratatui TUI 升级**：全面切换至 Peer Frost 2.0 配色，新增 Bot 右侧工作面板与 Classic 计划/目标侧边栏、OSC 8 `Cmd+Click` 文件超链接（兼容 Windows `file:///` URI）、圆角 Markdown 表格、思考过程流式展示、交互式 `request_user_input` 与 OAuth 配额监控。

zh.title: 优化
items: **打字首字符与输入框失焦零卡顿（#354）**：消除主进程计划/证据全盘扫描导致的 1.8 秒事件循环冻结，拆分输入框叶子状态并缓存渲染投影，解决首字符延迟与失焦卡顿。
**Bot 实时状态防闪动与去重（#356）**：为短工具调用引入 350ms 延迟显露阈值与单调递进步数提示，避免「思考中」与工具名 1 秒内来回跳闪；Bot 正在回复时不再额外渲染重复的「尚未确认这条消息的回复状态」行。
**子任务验收改为默认由主 Bot 决策、独立核验按需触发**：移除写类/文档子任务完成后默认阻塞的强制独立 Verifier 门禁（保留毫秒级磁盘确定性检查与按需手动复核），同步精简子任务顶栏与底栏中重复的「证据」入口与右侧面板布局，并与文档工作台自动互斥。
**智能输入补全体验优化（#340）**：裁剪超长 CJK 上下文、关闭补全推理档位、兼容代码块包裹 JSON 并修正单行幽灵预览裁剪。
桌面交互细节打磨：Bot 档案抽屉关闭按钮与页签合并为单行栏且支持跨页签开关（#331）、返回最新按钮悬浮覆盖在 Bot 对话区底部（#332）、模型设置已连接服务条精简为纯文本行（#334）、移除工作面板冗余静态底栏文案（#328）、修正模型选择器子菜单视口边界（#337）。
模型配置与 TUI 粘贴兼容：支持仅以 `reasoningEffortMap` 持久化推理强度的模型选项识别（#325），并合入 TS TUI 粘贴图片上传与含空格路径处理修复（#324、#326）。
守护进程传输层加固：有效防御半开 socket 与过期描述符，配合有界恢复围栏（bounded recovery fences）提升异常退出后的重连与恢复稳定性。
自动过滤模型回复中泄漏的 DSML 工具调用标记，保持对话输出整洁。
发布流水线完善：三端桌面打包均自动构建内置 Skill 市场目录并通过 `verify:packaged` 校验；npm 开放包（`@peer-agent/protocol`、`@peer-agent/runtime-core`、`@peer-agent/runtime-sdk`、`@peer-agent/cli`）继续随 `rc` dist-tag 同步发布。

zh.title: 修复
items: **Google / Gemini 原生协议与长思考断流全链路修复（#355）**：
升级 Gemini 工具声明至 `parametersJsonSchema`、规范化 `oneOf`/`anyOf` 与连续同角色 `contents`、适配 Gemini 3/4 `thinkingLevel`（含 `xhigh`）与 `thoughtSignature` 兼容降级、合并流式无签名分片并支持末尾 usage 帧；
移除写死的 30 秒 `read_timeout` 与 120 秒墙钟硬总超时，改为 `15s` 建连超时 + `300s` 按 chunk 刷新的流式静默超时，彻底解决深度思考模型频繁 `model_timeout` 断流；
对瞬态 `model_stream_incomplete`（提前 EOF / `MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL`）自动重试并透出具体 `finishReason` / HTTP 报错明细；
修复并发插队消息导致历史以 `model` 结尾触发 Google HTTP 400 的问题、心跳在熔断失败后死循环重放的问题，以及报错卡片被同轮 `agent_turn` 误折叠为「先前的中断」的问题。
**修复提供方列表 OAuth 刷新风暴与假死（#336）**、**静默唤醒空响应自取消死循环（#338）**与**子任务执行失败/核验失败生命周期混淆（#344）**。
修复 Windows 下工具产物落盘对只读句柄调用 `FlushFileBuffers` 导致的权限拒绝问题。
修复 Windows 下收件箱消费归档文件句柄未释放、协调恢复 `stat_token` 格式不一致与导出目录保留路径误判等问题。
修复 `project.bot.readEvidence` 在 Windows 盘符与 verbatim `\\?\` `file://` URI 下无法解析交付引用的问题。
移除工作面板注意力卡片残留的蓝色泛光。

zh.title: 已知问题
items: 独立 CLI 归档当前随本版本发布 `darwin-arm64` 与 `linux-x64` 两个目标；Windows 独立 CLI 归档（`peer-win32-x64.zip`）与 Windows 端 `peer update` 将在后续版本补齐（Windows 桌面版已完整内置 `peer-native.exe`）。

en.title: Notes
items: This release completes the Desktop convergence onto the native Rust Peer Core (ADR 133), introduces full Windows MSVC support for Rust Peer Core (`peer-native.exe`, zero `unsafe`) bundled across all three Desktop installers, and ships bot-level Skills/MCP mounting, the ADR 134 Desktop & Bot UX overhaul, the Peer Frost v2 matte visual system, and a major native TUI upgrade.

en.title: New Features
items: **Full Desktop convergence onto native Rust Peer Core (ADR 133)**: Classic Chat/Plan/Goal modes, Project Bot Host, Automations, Project Memory & Objectives, Shared Local Daemon, and remote device connectors all run on the native Rust Peer Core, retiring the legacy TypeScript desktop agent engine.

**Native Windows MSVC Rust Peer Core**: `peer-store`, `peer-runtime`, `peer-cli`, and `peer-core-rpc` build and pass tests natively on Windows MSVC (Windows Named Pipe daemon, UTF-8 PowerShell execution with `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, `sysinfo`-based process supervision, NTFS durability fixes, and zero `unsafe` code). macOS, Windows, and Linux Desktop installers all bundle `peer-native`, `peer-credential-helper`, and the built-in Skill marketplace catalog.

**GPT-6.2 subscription models (#335)**: Adds **GPT-6.2 Astra** (`gpt-6.2-astra`) and **GPT-6.2 Sol** (`gpt-6.2-sol`) to both the built-in ChatGPT subscription catalog and native CLI OAuth contracts (400K / 1M context tiers, 128K max output, full `low..max` reasoning efforts, official standard & >272K long-context pricing) and promotes `gpt-6.2-astra` as the default subscription model.

**Built-in read-only web search & batch search decoding (#348, #349)**: Adds built-in `web_search` (`local.web.search`) and `web_fetch` support for read-only research sessions and updates `BatchSearchToolCard` to decode Rust `local_tool_result_ref` payloads and failure states.

**Native OpenUI interactive results & Main Bot inline replies (#339, #341)**: Wires host-verified interactive result publication and inline rendering in chat bubbles for both Main Bot and delegated workers.

**Conversation-first subtask workspace & live inline delegation (#345, #350, #351)**: Redesigns the subtask view around the live native worker conversation, folds Rust worker stream rows into clean turns, and adds inline delegation acknowledgment rows in the main thread.

**Modular cat avatar studio & redesigned Bot home stage (#343, #346)**: Adds a 3-way color-harmonized modular cat avatar customizer, refreshed Bot welcome stage, and unified Peer executor icons across Work Panel and activity rows.
**Browser-style resource workspace header (#342)**: Streamlines the right document/delivery workbench header into compact browser-style tabs (ADR 125 Plan A).

**Bot-level Skills/MCP mounting, access inheritance, and default role model routing (#352, #353)**: Delegated sessions inherit the Bot's saved access policy and mounted capabilities; Rust core and Bot Settings apply default role-to-tier model routing.
**Retire Qoder CLI and Gemini OAuth (ADR 136, #347)**: Removes retired Qoder private adapters and Gemini OAuth code paths.

**ADR 134 Desktop & Project Bot UX overhaul**: Adds sidebar tasks, Touch Bar quick actions, full-width task workspace, human-voice dual-channel Bot UI, and redesigned Personalization with global communication style inheritance and `systemInstructions` wiring.

**Peer Frost v2 A×G matte visual system & brand startup**: Migrates all Desktop renderer stylesheets and redesigned model routing settings to unified matte tokens, introduces the bouncy cat silhouette perspective startup loader (#329), refreshes the website visuals (#330 `docs/`), eliminates unstyled loading flashes on deferred panels, and syncs `<html lang>`.

**Native Ratatui TUI overhaul**: Adopts the Peer Frost 2.0 palette and adds the Bot right work panel, Classic Plan/Goal task side panel, OSC 8 `Cmd+Click` file hyperlinks (including Windows `file:///` URIs), rounded Markdown tables, streaming reasoning/thinking display, interactive `request_user_input`, and OAuth quota monitoring.

en.title: Improvements
items: **Zero-stall first-character typing and blur responsiveness (#354)**: Eliminates 1.8s main-thread freezes caused by plan/evidence scans on input focus/typing and isolates composer draft state to leaf components.

**Flicker-free live Bot status & ghost-row suppression (#356)**: Adds a 350ms reveal threshold for fast local tool calls with monotonic step counts and suppresses duplicate unconfirmed restored rows while the Bot is actively running.

**Opt-in independent subtask verification & streamlined Task Details UI**: Delegated worker sessions now deliver directly back to the Main Bot for review without a mandatory automatic verifier gate (keeping instant on-disk file checks and on-demand manual re-verification); removes duplicate `Evidence` buttons/tabs, fixes inline evidence back-button labels and CSS, and makes the Task Details inspector mutually exclusive with the right Resource Workbench.
**Input prediction polish (#340)**: Trims long CJK context, disables reasoning for prediction requests, tolerates fenced JSON, and clips single-line ghost previews cleanly.

Desktop UI polish: inlines the Bot drawer close button with tabs and toggles cleanly across tabs (#331), floats the return-to-latest button over the Bot thread (#332), simplifies the connected-service strip in provider settings to a plain text row (#334), removes leftover static work-panel footer strings (#328), and keeps the model picker provider submenu within viewport bounds (#337).

Model config & TUI paste compatibility: supports reasoning effort selection persisted only via `reasoningEffortMap` (#325), and merges TUI pasted-image upload and space-containing path fixes (#324, #326).
Hardened daemon transport against half-open sockets and stale descriptors, paired with bounded recovery fences for reliable crash recovery.
Added DSML tool-markup sanitization to prevent leaked markup from polluting assistant replies.

Hardened the tri-platform release workflow to build the built-in Skill marketplace catalog on all Desktop targets and verify packaged native binaries via `verify:packaged`; npm packages (`@peer-agent/protocol`, `@peer-agent/runtime-core`, `@peer-agent/runtime-sdk`, `@peer-agent/cli`) continue publishing under the `rc` dist-tag.

en.title: Fixes
items: **Google / Gemini wire, long-reasoning streaming timeout, and error recovery (#355)**:

Upgrades Gemini tool declarations to `parametersJsonSchema`, normalizes `oneOf`/`anyOf` and consecutive same-role `contents`, adds Gemini 3/4 `thinkingLevel` (`xhigh`) and unsigned historical `functionCall` lowering, coalesces plain stream chunks, and handles trailing usage-only SSE frames;
Replaces the hardcoded 30s `read_timeout` and 120s hard wall-clock cutoff with a 15s connect timeout and a 300s per-chunk inactivity timeout so deep-thinking reasoning models no longer drop mid-turn;
Automatically retries transient `model_stream_incomplete` flakes (premature EOF / `MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL`) and surfaces structured `finishReason` / HTTP error details;

Repositions out-of-order queued user inputs past late assistant replies (fixing Gemini HTTP 400 `Requests ending with a model turn are not supported`), stops heartbeat replay loops after circuit-breaker trips, and prevents failed turn `agent_unavailable` cards from self-superseding into collapsed history.
**Fixed provider-list OAuth refresh storm livelock (#336)**, **quiet-wake empty-response self-cancel loops (#338)**, and **execution vs. verification failure lifecycle projection (#344)**.
Fixed Windows access-denied errors caused by calling `FlushFileBuffers` on read-only handles when syncing tool artifacts.
Fixed Windows inbox archival handle retention, `coordination_recovery` `stat_token` parity, and export destination reserved-path collisions.
Fixed `project.bot.readEvidence` failing to resolve delivery references for Windows drive and verbatim `\\?\` `file://` URIs.
Removed the residual blue wash from the work panel attention card.

en.title: Known Issues
items: Standalone CLI archives ship for `darwin-arm64` and `linux-x64` in this release; the standalone Windows CLI archive (`peer-win32-x64.zip`) and Windows `peer update` support are planned for a follow-up release (Windows Desktop already bundles `peer-native.exe`).
